description: This file defines a class for formatting .NET types for database storage, specifically for use with ADO.NET in various Orleans storage scenarios. It implements IFormatProvider and provides custom formatting logic for dates, strings, and null values.

classes.name: AdoNetFormatProvider
classes.description: Provides formatting for .NET types to be used in database queries, implementing IFormatProvider.

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.description: Returns an instance of the formatter if the requested format type is ICustomFormatter.

nested_classes.name: AdoNetFormatter
nested_classes.description: Implements ICustomFormatter to convert objects to database-ready string representations.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Converts an object to a string suitable for SQL queries, handling nulls, strings, DateTime, DateTimeOffset, and other IFormattable objects.

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal formatter instance if the requested type is ICustomFormatter.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats an input object into its database string representation, handling various data types.
